entry: Fixed a region's strategy-label text box overflowing the screen edge on narrow phones.
The warming-rate info toggle now states a concrete calibration (roughly 50 real-world years per round, from NOAA's warming rate) instead of a vague "several years" disclaimer.

Fixed a performance bug where long sessions could make Advance Round take multiple seconds and climbing, caused by how the (intentionally worst-case) Region D reinvested its own growing income each round.
Fixed a display bug where the What's New panel showed as an empty box before its first open and never visually closed again once opened once.
G11: a new Community Comparison panel shows how your average warming-acceleration factor stacks up against everyone else's, once enough players have saved to compare against.
Z6: the personal-best label's "just improved" badge flash moved into the new shared shared/personal-best.css (also used by Canopy and Tide) instead of a per-game copy of the same rule.

Round-2 polish: temperature trend arrows, a stability streak counter, a scientist's log of key moments, a labelled melt-threshold line, warning icons on critical status, preset purchase previews, pre-emptive-investment praise, and a per-region personal best.
Added a settings panel (text size + reduced motion) and completed a colorblind-safety audit — the tipping/dampening flashes are already redundantly coded with text, no change needed.

Achievements system added (18 achievements) plus the G1-G20 improvement pass: richer secondary-region readouts, a best-region comparison, preset strategies, a worst-case Region D, and a per-browser personal best.
Added a skippable tutorial, a How to Play page, and a mobile sticky HUD.
Full visual redesign: starfield/space-themed backdrop, glass panels, icon labels and count chips.
Integrated the shared save widget and fixed load_state() crashing outright on missing save fields.
Pass 3 balance fix: the intervention lever now gives an immediate, legible efficacy readout instead of a silent number with no felt effect pre-melt.
Added an in-game Info Page with real-world permafrost sources; Pass 2 added a multi-region side-by-side comparison.
Iteration pass: a tipping-point screen flash and an alarming melt state, so the feedback loop's onset lands as a distinct moment.

All 7 core milestones shipped: background trajectory + core loop, permafrost melt + methane feedback, intervention measures, visible acceleration, hope-angle payoff, feedback prompt, and hub integration.
